messages:
nina: Starting shadow run for fp8 kernel on H100/L40S. Observing a recurring 'token-floor' - early tokens returned as repeated <unk>-like outputs during longprefix cases. Running against atlas13b and orbit7B models.

will: Noted similar in canary yesterday but thought it was batch-size = 1 warmup noise. Can you paste the run command and perf/eval snippets?

nina: cmd: ```./run_shadow.sh --model atlas13b --device h100 --quant fp8 --batch 1 --seq 2048 --shadow true --trace tokens.log``` metrics: top1-acc drop ~0.8% on eval-suite after 2k prefix, latency OK. Logs: ```[WARN] activation_scale clamp at layer 4: 1.2e-2 -> 9e-3``` Also saw KV cache reuse flag toggled per request.

sam: Interesting. Two hypotheses: 1) activation scaling underflow for small warmup batches; 2) interleaved mixed-precision path picking different kernels on L40S/H100 variants. Did you run with --force-kernel=fp8-standard?

nina: ran that too, still see token-floor but reduced severity (drop 0.3%). Difference seems correlated with prefix length and whether prefix contains many repeated tokens. Replicate script: ```python repro.py --prefix_length 1800 --seed 42``` attached in thread.

yu: Which quant backend? AWQ or GPTQ? AWQ sometimes packs/scales per-channel differently and can cause per-layer bias.

nina: AWQ for these runs. We also did GPTQ runs — GPTQ had much smaller delta but cost is higher and memory differs.

sasha: Two quick checks: 1) try forcing fp16 activations with fp8 weights (--act-prec fp16) to see if it's scaling-only; 2) run shadow with batch=8 to warm KV cache and see if it mitigates. Also add eval of full prompt set to surface regression hysteresis.

nina: running both now. Quick results: act-prec=fp16 removes token-floor entirely on H100 but L40S still shows small blips. Batch=8 reduces but doesn't eliminate. Attach eval diffs: ```devset: baseline=0.912, fp8-awq-shadow=0.905, fp8-awq-actfp16=0.913```

will: Sounds like a hybrid issue: fp8 weight quant + per-device kernel selection + act-scale heuristics. We should add a metric to trace per-layer activation_scale and kernel-choice in the console (per-request traces) so we can correlate.

ci-bot: deploy-shadow run 4842007890 completed for atlas13b on h100-l40s cluster. Artifacts at s3://redwood-shadows/4842007890/

sasha: If actfp16 fixes H100 but not L40S, maybe L40S kernel uses a different accumulation path or different denom for scale. File a kernel ticket and include `tokens.log` + activation histograms.

nina: Filed ENG-ML-3249 with logs + small repro. Next step: try int8 AWQ profile to see if pure int8 path avoids the scaling trickery. Will update.

will: Good plan. Also test with longer warmups and with prefix token diversity to ensure it's not repeated-token edge case.

nina: thanks all. keeping thread open until we get kernel PR or clear opt-in config. :thumbsup:
